en: A vintage monochrome (blue-toned) postcard showing a panoramic cityscape with a prominent flat-topped hill bearing ancient ruins on the left, likely the Acropolis overlooking the city. Foreground includes urban buildings; on the right edge there is a dark silhouette of a tree. The photo is printed within a light border that contains handwritten cursive text along the vertical right side and left margin. The lower part has a faint circular stamp and the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.
